Ready and paused. No full audit or numerical work ran.

Helper on both hosts: treams-artifact-audit.py SHA256: 61a89523244399692889aecfaf7740201201c9b14ec9e3f1b276e69771f902d4

After corrected measurements finish, run:

# Mac
.venv/bin/python treams-artifact-audit.py \
  treams-rs-browser mac \
  broad scaling thread-scaling gradient correction-boundary illumination \
  accuracy-physics accuracy-references accuracy-upstream \
  --cohort corrected > treams-corrected-evidence-mac.json

# Linux, from its checkout
.venv/bin/python treams-artifact-audit.py \
  treams-rs linux \
  broad scaling thread-scaling gradient correction-boundary illumination \
  accuracy-physics accuracy-references accuracy-upstream gpu \
  --cohort corrected > treams-corrected-evidence-linux.json

Checks:

  • Correction-plan coverage and unchanged commands/metadata.
  • Current numerical, Python, native, harness and GPU executable fingerprints.
  • Finished states, attempts, durable sidecars, stdout/result equality.
  • Repetitions, medians, paired speedups, RSS consistency.
  • Gradient NPZ hashes and ZIP integrity.
  • Schema-specific accuracy and illumination gates; upstream disagreements retained.
  • GPU samples versus explicitly marked medians-only evidence.

Exit 1 means integrity errors; 2 means intact evidence with unresolved case/native qualification failures.

Six bounded temporary fixture types passed integrity checks. The old Mie failure remained visible; deliberate median/stdout corruption was detected. GPU schema was inspected but awaits final execution. This does not recompute numerical arrays, certify build provenance beyond recorded hashes, validate plots, or measure VRAM.
